scripts.build: npm run build -w @psyche/engine -w @psyche/faculties && npm run build -w @psyche/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/engine packages/faculties packages/server && npm run typecheck -w @psyche/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web "npm run dev -w @psyche/server" "npm run dev -w @psyche/web"
scripts.start: npm run build -w @psyche/web && npm run start -w @psyche/server
